data.name: TranscriptEmpty
data.value: Press Start: the transcript appears here as people speak.

data.name: EngineStarting
data.value: Starting the engine (the first start loads the models)…

data.name: EngineStartFailed
data.value: The engine could not be started. Check Engine:PythonPath and Engine:WorkingDirectory in appsettings.json.

data.name: ModelLoading
data.value: Loading the speech model — already recording

data.name: NoSystemSignal
data.value: No sound from the system audio for 30 s. Check the Windows default output device and your headphones.

data.name: HistoryEmpty
data.value: No sessions yet. Your recordings will appear here.

data.name: AskPlaceholder
data.value: Ask a question, e.g. what did we decide about the beta?

data.name: AskConnectionLost
data.value: The connection to the engine was lost before the answer finished. Ask again.

data.name: HistorySelect
data.value: Select a session to read its transcript and minutes.

data.name: NoMinutes
data.value: No minutes yet. Use “Regenerate minutes” to write them.

data.name: SettingsSaved
data.value: Settings saved. They apply from the next recording.

data.name: SettingsRestartRequired
data.value: These settings apply after the engine restarts:

data.name: EngineRestarted
data.value: The engine restarted with the new settings.

data.name: EngineRestartManual
data.value: The engine was started outside the app. Restart it yourself to apply these settings.

data.name: EngineRestartFailed
data.value: The engine did not start again. Check the settings you changed.

data.name: SettingHelp_APP_LANGUAGE
data.value: Language of the app, the engine messages and the minutes headings.

data.name: SettingHelp_TRANSCRIPTION_LANGUAGE
data.value: Language the meeting is held in, preselected on the Recording tab. Empty follows the interface language.

data.name: SettingHelp_MIC_LABEL
data.value: Name shown for your microphone in transcripts. Empty uses “Me”.

data.name: SettingHelp_SYSTEM_LABEL
data.value: Name shown for the other participants (system audio). Empty uses “Others”.

data.name: SettingHelp_OUTPUT_DIR
data.value: Folder where each session gets its own subfolder with its audio (and, with the files storage, its transcript and minutes).

data.name: SettingHelp_STORAGE_BACKEND
data.value: sqlite keeps sessions, transcripts and minutes in one database (vozata.db); files keeps one folder of JSON and Markdown files per session. Audio stays in the recordings folder either way.

data.name: SettingHelp_DATABASE_PATH
data.value: The SQLite database file; empty uses vozata.db in the recordings folder. Keep it out of OneDrive-synced folders: sync can lock or corrupt it while VozAta runs.

data.name: SettingHelp_AUDIO_CACHE_MB
data.value: sqlite only: WAV files built from the database when a tool needs a file (speaker identification) are kept in the cache folder of the recordings folder, up to this size; the least recently used go first.

data.name: SettingHelp_GENERATE_MINUTES
data.value: Generate the minutes with the local language model after each recording.

data.name: SettingHelp_AUTOSAVE_SECONDS
data.value: How often the session file is saved while recording (1 to 300 s). After a crash the interrupted session is found and can be recovered on the next start.

data.name: SettingHelp_SAMPLE_RATE
data.value: Internal audio sample rate. Whisper requires 16000.

data.name: SettingHelp_MIX_MODE
data.value: mixed.wav as one mono track, or stereo with the microphone left and the system audio right.

data.name: SettingHelp_CHUNK_MODE
data.value: vad cuts at the pauses between phrases (faster and more accurate); fixed uses windows of the length below.

data.name: SettingHelp_CHUNK_SECONDS
data.value: Length of each transcription window when audio is cut in fixed windows.

data.name: SettingHelp_VAD_THRESHOLD
data.value: How sure the voice detector must be that a sound is speech (0.01 to 0.99). Raise it for noisy rooms.

data.name: SettingHelp_VAD_MIN_SILENCE_MS
data.value: A silence at least this long after speech ends a chunk.

data.name: SettingHelp_VAD_MIN_CHUNK_SECONDS
data.value: Speech shorter than this is not sent alone; it joins the next phrase.

data.name: SettingHelp_VAD_MAX_CHUNK_SECONDS
data.value: Longer speech is cut at its longest pause, or at this limit.

data.name: SettingHelp_VAD_SPEECH_PAD_MS
data.value: Audio kept before the first word of a phrase so it is not clipped.

data.name: SettingHelp_STT_PROVIDER
data.value: Speech-to-text provider. faster_whisper runs locally on your GPU or CPU.

data.name: SettingHelp_WHISPER_MODEL
data.value: Model used on the GPU, e.g. large-v3-turbo or large-v3.

data.name: SettingHelp_WHISPER_DEVICE
data.value: auto uses the GPU when available, otherwise the CPU.

data.name: SettingHelp_WHISPER_COMPUTE_TYPE
data.value: Numeric precision on the GPU; int8_float16 fits a 6 GB card.

data.name: SettingHelp_WHISPER_CPU_MODEL
data.value: Smaller model used when no GPU is available.

data.name: SettingHelp_WHISPER_KEEP_LOADED
data.value: Keep Whisper in memory between recordings so the next one transcribes at once. It is still released before minutes are written.

data.name: SettingHelp_TAIL_MARGIN_SECONDS
data.value: Words ending this close to the end of a window wait for the next one.

data.name: SettingHelp_PAUSE_GAP_SECONDS
data.value: A gap between words this long counts as the end of a phrase.

data.name: SettingHelp_MAX_CARRY_SECONDS
data.value: Unfinished speech carried to the next window is committed once it reaches this length.

data.name: SettingHelp_SILENCE_RMS_THRESHOLD
data.value: Audio quieter than this (RMS, 0 to 1) is treated as silence and not transcribed.

data.name: SettingHelp_LIVE_PARTIALS
data.value: Show provisional text while someone is still speaking; the final line replaces it.

data.name: SettingHelp_PARTIAL_INTERVAL_SECONDS
data.value: Minimum time between two updates of the provisional text of a channel.

data.name: SettingHelp_ECHO_DEDUPE_ENABLED
data.value: Drop microphone lines that repeat what the speakers played, for meetings without headphones.

data.name: SettingHelp_ECHO_SIMILARITY
data.value: Share of a microphone line's words (0.5 to 1) heard at the same time in the system audio for the line to count as echo.

data.name: SettingHelp_ECHO_HOLD_SECONDS
data.value: How long microphone lines wait for the matching system line; they appear this much later. Empty: segment length + 3 s.

data.name: SettingHelp_VOCABULARY_FILE
data.value: Text file with one term per line (# starts a comment), edited in the Vocabulary card above. Empty: vocabulary.txt next to the engine .env.

data.name: SettingHelp_CONTEXT_PROMPT_CHARS
data.value: How much of each channel's recent text is given to the speech model to keep names and spelling consistent (0 to 1000, 0 = off).

data.name: VocabularyHelp
data.value: Names, acronyms and product terms the speech model should recognize and the minutes should spell this way. Used in every recording.

data.name: VocabularyImportHint
data.value: Paste terms separated by commas or new lines

data.name: SessionTermsHint
data.value: Names and terms, separated by commas or new lines

data.name: SettingHelp_TRANSLATE_TO
data.value: Translate each transcript line into this language while recording (shown under the line, saved to transcript.translated.jsonl). The Start screen can choose another language per meeting. Runs on the CPU.

data.name: SettingHelp_TRANSLATION_PROVIDER
data.value: opus_mt: Opus-MT models on CTranslate2. Needs the optional engine extra "translation".

data.name: SettingHelp_TRANSLATION_MODEL_DIR
data.value: Folder with opus-mt-ROMANCE-en and opus-mt-en-ROMANCE. Empty: downloaded once (about 155 MB each) into the Hugging Face cache.

data.name: SettingHelp_LLM_PROVIDER
data.value: Language-model provider used to write the minutes.

data.name: SettingHelp_OLLAMA_URL
data.value: Address of the local Ollama server.

data.name: SettingHelp_OLLAMA_MODEL
data.value: Ollama model that writes the minutes; it must fit in your GPU memory.

data.name: SettingHelp_LLM_MAX_CHARS
data.value: Longer transcripts are summarized in parts first, then combined.

data.name: SettingHelp_MINUTES_TEMPLATE
data.value: Template preselected on the Start screen; each session and each regeneration can pick another one.

data.name: SettingHelp_OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE
data.value: How long Ollama keeps the model after the minutes: 0 frees the GPU at once, 5m keeps it 5 minutes.

data.name: SettingHelp_API_HOST
data.value: Address the local engine listens on. Never use 0.0.0.0: the API has no authentication.

data.name: SettingHelp_API_PORT
data.value: Port of the local engine. The desktop app must use the same port.

data.name: SettingHelp_OPENAI_STT_URL
data.value: Base URL of an OpenAI-style speech API used when the recognition engine is openai_compatible, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or https://api.groq.com/openai/v1. Audio is sent there.

data.name: SettingHelp_OPENAI_STT_KEY
data.value: Key of the external speech API. It is stored in the engine's .env file and never shown again.

data.name: SettingHelp_OPENAI_STT_MODEL
data.value: Model of the external speech API, e.g. whisper-1 (OpenAI) or whisper-large-v3 (Groq). Check the provider's price per minute.

data.name: SettingHelp_DIARIZATION_ENABLED
data.value: After a recording stops, tell the people in the system audio apart and label them User 1, User 2… Needs the optional diarization extra and a Hugging Face token.

data.name: SettingHelp_DIARIZATION_PROVIDER
data.value: Engine provider that identifies the speakers, e.g. pyannote.

data.name: SettingHelp_DIARIZATION_DEVICE
data.value: Where speaker identification runs: auto, cuda (NVIDIA GPU) or cpu. It runs after the speech model is released.

data.name: SettingHelp_HF_TOKEN
data.value: Access token for the pyannote models. Create it on huggingface.co and accept the model terms there first.

data.name: SettingHelp_MIN_SPEAKERS
data.value: Smallest number of remote people to expect (1 to 20). Leave empty to detect it.

data.name: SettingHelp_MAX_SPEAKERS
data.value: Largest number of remote people to expect (1 to 20). Leave empty to detect it.

data.name: SettingHelp_LIVE_DIARIZATION_ENABLED
data.value: Label remote speakers (User 1, User 2…) while recording. Needs the diarization extra and HF_TOKEN; the labels are corrected when the session stops.

data.name: SettingHelp_SPEAKER_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD
data.value: How similar (0.05 to 1) a voice must be to join an existing speaker. Lower merges voices, higher splits one voice into several.

data.name: ConfirmCloseMessage
data.value: A recording is in progress. Stop it and close VozAta? The audio and transcript recorded so far are kept.

data.name: SettingHelp_LOW_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD
data.value: Words recognized with a probability below this (0 to 1) are highlighted in the session transcript.

data.name: TranscriptSaved
data.value: Transcript updated. Regenerate the minutes so they use it.

data.name: TranscriptLowConfidenceHint
data.value: Highlighted words were recognized with low confidence.

data.name: TranscriptEmptySegment
data.value: A line cannot be empty. Type its text, or cancel the change.

data.name: ConfirmDiscardEditsMessage
data.value: Your transcript corrections are not saved. Discard them?

data.name: ConfirmRevertMessage
data.value: Remove all your corrections and show the original transcript again? The minutes change only when you regenerate them.

data.name: SpeakersIntro
data.value: Give the people in this recording their real names. Leave a name empty to keep the default label.

data.name: SpeakersRegeneratePrompt
data.value: Names saved. The minutes still use the old names.

data.name: SpeakersRegenerate
data.value: Regenerate minutes with the new names

data.name: SpeakersEmpty
data.value: No speakers yet: this session has no transcript.

data.name: ActionItemsEmpty
data.value: No action items for this meeting. Use "Extract again" to look for them in the transcript.

data.name: ActionItemsExtracting
data.value: Extracting action items from the transcript…

data.name: ActionItemsNoTargets
data.value: To export, set up Azure DevOps or GitHub in Settings → Task export.

data.name: ActionItemsExportFailed
data.value: Not exported: {0}. The reason is shown under each item.

data.name: SettingHelp_EXTRACT_ACTION_ITEMS
data.value: After the minutes, list the tasks agreed in the meeting (description, owner, due date).

data.name: SettingHelp_AZDO_ORG_URL
data.value: For example https://dev.azure.com/my-org. Leave empty to not offer Azure DevOps.

data.name: SettingHelp_AZDO_PROJECT
data.value: Project where the Task work items are created.

data.name: SettingHelp_AZDO_PAT
data.value: Personal access token with the Work Items (Read & write) scope. Stored only in .env.

data.name: SettingHelp_GITHUB_REPO
data.value: owner/name of the repository that receives the issues. Leave empty to not offer GitHub.

data.name: SettingHelp_GITHUB_TOKEN
data.value: Token allowed to create issues in the repository. Stored only in .env.

data.name: RecoveryMessage
data.value: VozAta closed while these sessions were recording. Recover them to repair the audio and finish the transcript, speakers and minutes with what was saved. The last few seconds before the crash may be missing.

data.name: MeetingsEmpty
data.value: No meetings in this week. Record one on the Recorder page, or go back a week.

data.name: MeetingDeleteRecycle
data.value: “{0}” will be moved to the Recycle Bin with its transcript, minutes and audio. You can undo it for a few seconds, or restore it from the Recycle Bin later.

data.name: MeetingDeletePermanent
data.value: “{0}” will be deleted permanently with its transcript, minutes and audio. This cannot be undone.

data.name: MeetingNoAudio
data.value: This meeting has no mixed recording to play.

data.name: SettingOptionsUnreachable
data.value: The list could not be read: the service did not answer.

data.name: SettingInvalidUrl
data.value: Enter a full address that starts with http:// or https://.

data.name: ConnectionTestHint
data.value: Checks the service with the saved settings: save your changes first.

data.name: StorageAudioCacheHelp
data.value: WAV files made from the database for playback. They are made again when needed.

data.name: StorageClearCacheMessage
data.value: The cached WAV files are deleted. The recordings stay in the database and are cached again when you play them.

data.name: MigrationPaused
data.value: Importing old meetings paused while recording ({0} of {1})

data.name: MigrationFailed
data.value: Importing the old meetings failed; it will be tried again at the next start.

data.name: MigrationKeepFolders
data.value: The original folders are kept: keep a backup until you have checked the imported meetings.

data.name: MeetingDeleteAudioMessage
data.value: The audio of “{0}” will be deleted permanently to free disk space. The transcript, minutes and action items are kept. Export the recording first if you may want to listen to it again.

data.name: MeetingAudioDeleted
data.value: Audio deleted. The transcript and minutes were kept.

data.name: MeetingImportTitle
data.value: Import a meeting exported by VozAta (.zip)

data.name: Processing_TabPending
data.value: This part is still being processed.

data.name: Close_PendingProcessing
data.value: {0} meeting(s) are still being processed. Processing resumes the next time VozAta opens.
